hero.h1: Made to measure. Designed, built and fitted by us.
hero.sub: Wardrobes, kitchens and media walls across Flemish Brabant and Brussels. We draw them, our dedicated workshop builds them to measure, and we fit them.
strip.1d: Always the same workshop, building only to our drawings.
strip.2d: From measuring to fitting, the same team throughout.
strip.3d: No standard units — every piece built to your dimensions.
work.sub: Every piece below was drawn, built and fitted by us. Filter by room, or by finish using the swatches further down.
rooms.sub: Pick a room to see only that work.
feat1.h: Every centimetre of the room, used
feat1.p: Sloping ceilings, walls that aren't straight, pipes running through: that's where it's decided. Because everything is built specifically for your room, each carcass is made to the real dimension instead of being covered up with filler panels.
feat1.li1: Measured on site, not chosen from a catalogue
feat1.li2: Cut to the angle of the roof or the wall
feat1.li3: Doors adjusted and aligned before we leave
feat2.p: We draw the kitchen with you, our dedicated workshop builds it to measure, we bring it over and we fit it. One point of contact for the whole thing — no passing the blame between supplier and fitter.
feat2.li1: Fronts, carcasses and worktops from one production run
feat2.li2: Built-in appliances designed into the plan
feat2.li3: Delivery and fitting by our own team
colors.sub: Click a finish to see the work that uses it. This is a selection — almost any colour or timber is possible.
colors.note: On-screen colours are no substitute for a sample: the real tone depends on the light in your room. We bring samples to the site visit.
process.h2: From first message to finished room
process.sub: Because the drawing, the manufacturing and the fitting are all ours, you know from the start who is responsible for what.
p1.d: Send a message with a photo of the room and the outline of what you want.
p2.d: We come round, measure up and go through layout, materials and colour.
p3.d: You get a drawing and a fixed price. Production starts only once you agree.
p4.d: Everything is made to your dimensions in our dedicated workshop, then brought here.
p5.d: Our team fits, adjusts and clears up. You check it over before we leave.
about.h2: From drawing to fitting, always the same people
about.p1: DO HAB builds made-to-measure furniture for households and small businesses: wardrobes, walk-ins, kitchens, media walls and bathroom units.
about.p2: The difference is in how the work is organised: we draw it and take the measurements, one dedicated workshop builds everything to those plans, and our own team fits it. No chain of subcontractors, no supplier that changes from job to job — and that shows up in the price as well as the finish.
about.p3: We work mainly in Flemish Brabant and Brussels, in Dutch, French and English.
contact.sub: A photo of the room and a rough idea of the dimensions is enough to start. A call or a WhatsApp works too.

form.note: Your details are used only to answer this request and are not passed on to anyone.
